children: Extreme Networks reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $341.1 million, up 9.9% from the prior-year quarter, while net income rose to $16 million from $5.6 million and diluted EPS increased to $0.12 from $0.04.
Revenue was $341.1M, compared with $310.2M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 9.9%.
Net income was $16.0M, compared with $5.6M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 184.9%.
Diluted EPS was $0.12, compared with $0.04 in the prior-year quarter.
Product revenue grew 12.5%, supported by higher average selling prices, favorable mix and stronger demand; subscription and support revenue increased 5.7%.
SaaS annual recurring revenue rose 22.4% to $264.7 million, driven by adoption of cloud network management, including Extreme Platform ONE.
Extreme Agent ONE Coworker became generally available in calendar third-quarter 2026. Operator mode is expected in early 2027.
Management cited a multi-year refresh cycle led by Wi-Fi 7 and campus modernization, alongside demand for integrated networking, security and AI automation.
